sn51.1:1.1: Cattāro me bhikkhave iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā aparāparaṃ gamanāya {saṃvattanti} || Katame cattāro || || Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgatam iddhipādam bhāveti || viriyasamādhipadhānasaṅkharasamannāgatam iddhipādam bhāveti || cittasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgatam iddhipādam bhāveti || vīmaṃsasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādam bhāveti || || Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro iddhipādā bhāvitā bahulīkatā aparāparaṅgamanāya saṃvattantī ti || ||
